definition_zh: 恩人；捐助人；资助人；行善者
definition_en: a person who gives money or other help to a person, cause, or organization
core_image: 在捐赠名单顶端签下名字、把钱袋递给学校的人
scene: 新图书馆落成那天，人们把最大的感谢献给他。The library's marble wall lists the name of its chief benefactor.
sceneCN: 这里 benefactor 是「捐助人、恩人」（第 1 个义项：出资出力的行善者）；句意是图书馆的大理石墙上刻着主要捐助人的名字。

derivatives.zh: 由同根动词性成分加名词后缀构成，义为「善行；捐款」
阴性形式，义为「女恩人；女捐助人」
同根关联词，义为「受益人」

senses.title: A person who gives money or help
senses.definition: someone who supports a person, school, hospital, or cause with money or aid
senses.definitionCN: 以钱财或帮助支持个人、学校、医院或事业的人
senses.example: The library's marble wall lists the name of its chief benefactor.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆的大理石墙上刻着主要捐助人的名字。
senses.why: Bene means good and factor means a doer, so the word names a doer of good.
senses.whyCN: bene 意为「好」，factor 意为「做事的人」，合起来即「行善之人」。

senses.title: A protector or patron in a broader sense
senses.definition: anyone who looks after or promotes another's welfare, not only with money
senses.definitionCN: 广义上护佑、提携他人的人，不限于出资
senses.example: The professor was a quiet benefactor to generations of young scholars.
senses.exampleCN: 这位教授是几代年轻学者默默的扶助者。
senses.why: Doing good can mean opening doors, not only opening a purse.
senses.whyCN: 「行善」不只是掏钱，也可以是为人开门引路。

intro.en: Benefactor is Latin bene, well, plus factor, a doer.
intro.cn: benefactor 由拉丁语 bene「好」加 factor「做事者」构成。

items.en: the root dhe- meant to set, to do.
items.cn: 词根 dhe- 意为「放置、做」（重构形式）。

items.en: benefactor meant a doer of good, from bene plus facere.
items.cn: 拉丁语 benefactor 意为「行善者」，由 bene 加 facere 构成。

items.en: the title was used for kings and patrons in inscriptions.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语铭文中用作君王与赞助人的尊称。

items.en: English adopted benefactor in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语采纳 benefactor 一词。

items.en: it now names donors to schools, museums, and charities.
items.cn: 如今多指向学校、博物馆、慈善机构捐资的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bene- or fact- roots; the near-meaning group gathers words for givers and supporters.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bene- 或 fact- 词根；近义组汇集给予者、支持者类词。

entries.definitionCN: 善行；捐款——benefactor 的行为名词
作恶者——前缀相反的对照词
有益的——同含 bene- 词根

entries.definition: a regular supporter, especially of the arts
one who gives money or blood or organs
one who promotes human welfare by large gifts
entries.definitionCN: 慈善家；规模与事业心更强

normalIntro.en: Benefactor is bene plus factor: one who does good.
normalIntro.cn: benefactor 是 bene 加 factor：行善之人。

normal.en: Malefactor is the opposite, an evildoer.
normal.cn: malefactor 是反义词，指作恶者。
benefit 同含 bene- 词根。

normal.en: Fact- roots give factory and manufacture.

abstract.en: See a name carved at the top of a donor wall.
abstract.cn: 看捐助墙上顶端的名字。

abstract.en: Feel a heavy purse passed into open hands.
abstract.cn: 感受钱袋递入摊开的双手。

abstract.en: Picture a roof raised over many students.
abstract.cn: 想象为众多学子撑起的屋顶。

examples.en: The library's marble wall lists the name of its chief benefactor.
examples.cn: 图书馆的大理石墙上刻着主要捐助人的名字。

examples.en: The professor was a quiet benefactor to generations of young scholars.
examples.cn: 这位教授是几代年轻学者默默的扶助者。

examples.en: An anonymous benefactor paid the hospital's new wing.
examples.cn: 一位匿名捐助人出资修建了医院的新楼。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「宝内·发克它」——宝在自己口袋里，却发出去给别人用，这样的人是恩人。

root: 拉丁语 bene「好地」加 facere「做」的施动者形式 factor「做事者」，合为「行善者」；词根 facere 上溯至原始印欧语词根 dhe-「放置、做」（重构形式），于十五世纪经拉丁语进入英语。同根词有 benefit、malefactor、factory 等。

sensesIntro.en: One noun names doers of good, from marble-wall donors to quiet mentors.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个名词，既指刻上大理石墙的捐资者，也指默默扶助的引路人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name signed at the top of a donor wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：捐助名单顶端签下的名字。

intro.en: Benefactor joins the good root bene- to the doing root fact-.
intro.cn: benefactor 把「好」词根 bene- 与「做」词根 fact- 相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb facere powers this whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 facere 驱动着整个词族。

items.meaning: to make by hand or machine

latinEntries.meaning: a doer of good; direct source of the English word
latinEntries.meaningCN: 行善者；英语词的直接来源
